Chief Urk-Tar

Biography

Chief Urk-Tar leads an orc tribe on Gipath. He welcomes Kir after the struggle against the Khadaganian expedition and invokes the earlier Chosen and Shei-Var as examples. His dealings with the travellers involve a ritual axe, a harpy hunt and conflict with humans advancing into the Foothills. The struggle over the Shell can turn the local lizards against the settlers. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
